notes: Compressive strength format finalised for the C&W rate items 49 (PCC cube), 50 (cylinder), 51 (cylinder with capping), 52 (bricks) and 56 (core with capping)
Each specimen follows its own standard: cylinder ASTM C39/C39M / AASHTO T 22; cube BS EN 12390-3; core ASTM C42/C42M / AASHTO T 24 (with L/D correction factor); brick ASTM C67/C67M

Acceptance by the right rule: cylinders ACI 318 (avg ≥ f′c, each ≥ f′c − 500 PSI); cubes BS EN 206 (mean ≥ fck + 1 MPa, each ≥ fck − 4 MPa); cores ACI 318 (avg ≥ 0.85 f′c, each ≥ 0.75 f′c); bricks specified minimum
New Size column (diameter or L × W), Type of fracture for cylinders, strengths to the nearest 10 PSI
Age is the actual age from casting and testing dates (typed age only when a date is missing)
